<!-- Copilot workspace instructions for the Portfolio project -->

- This is a plain HTML/CSS/JS portfolio — no framework, no build tool required.

- All styles live in `css/style.css` using CSS custom properties (variables).

- JavaScript is in `js/main.js` — vanilla ES6+, no dependencies.

- Keep the design dark-themed (`--clr-bg: #0f0f14`) with purple accent (`--clr-accent: #7c6af7`).

- Maintain responsive layout; use the existing breakpoints (768px, 480px).

- Do not introduce npm, bundlers, or external JS libraries unless explicitly requested.

- Placeholder content is marked with HTML comments `<!-- Replace ... -->`.s
